findings.evidence: The conclusion textarea renders about 6 lines of narrative inside a box over 650 px tall. It runs past the bottom of the 3,277 px capture, so the info note, clinician-assessment field and recommendations card do not appear at all. Blank space ends up as the largest region on the page. ImpressionBlock.tsx uses Mantine autosize with minRows 6 and maxRows 24, so the box should hug its content. This looks like autosize measuring before layout settled, or the capture resizing the viewport. Check it in the live browser before fixing.
findings.recommendation: Check at a live 768×1024 viewport. If the textarea really grows to maxRows, make the autosize measurement re-run after the form settles (or on width change) so it fits its 6 lines. If it cannot be reproduced live, fix the capture step and recapture this variant. This verdict is based on a partial artifact.

findings.evidence: rgb(43, 108, 176) carries 5 unrelated meanings (border, bullet-or-dot, button, icon, text) across 16 marks: one color, one meaning (measured 5, threshold 3), from composition-metrics.mjs. Sample selectors: emr-view-toggle-bilateral, the emr-content-section-header tick, drawing-mode-toggle-click, drawing-size-4, drawing-tool-pen. My reading: every flagged mark is brand selected-state or section chrome, not a clinical severity signal. In dark mode, theme.css sets --emr-info to #2b6cb0 (line 1596), and these selected-state and tick tokens resolve to that same value, so the blue on the active toggle and pen tool is literally the info notice's color. This is new since round 2 because the bigger drawing toolbar is now inside the measured area.
findings.recommendation: TOKEN/TOOLING DECISION, route to the founder. Either (a) move the dark-mode selected-state and tick tokens (--emr-selected-border, the view-toggle and drawing-toolbar active fill, the section tick) to a brand value that differs from dark --emr-info, so info blue only appears on the 'findings changed' notice; or (b) declare in DESIGN-DIRECTION that info blue in dark mode is shared with brand chrome, and add those tokens to the metric's brandTokens. Option (a) follows the collision rule as written.
